messages:
Rina Kapoor: Heads-up 1 1 We need a tight microasset bundle for next week's launch: one 1-page benchmark sheet, 3 social tiles (metric / quote / CTA), webinar hero (email + slide), a tiny latency vs cost microdiagram, and a single-slide inbound routing play. Goal: clean, scannable, mobile-first. Deadline: Thu EOD. Can design take? cc @Tom @Priya

Tom Alvarez: Yep. I'll own the social tiles + hero. Quick asks: do we need localized CTAs (EN / DE) and does legal require translations for opt-in text?

Priya Singh: Localization: yes for DE and FR markets. Keep copy modular so designers can swap strings. Legal: opt-in copy must be accurate per region, @Lena can confirm. Also recommend shorter headlines for social A/B.

Lena Park: Confirmed: DE/FR opt-in copy needed on registration flows. Provide copy variations and we will run legal quick-check. Avoid medical/health claims in examples. Link: https://redwood.design/brand/guardrails

design-bot: Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/miniassets/serving-launch-2797777777 (auto)

Tom Alvarez: Uploaded draft tiles and sizes to Figma. Exports we plan:
- hero: 1200x628 (png + svg)
- social: 1080x1080 (jpg for socials, png for web)
- one-pager: US Letter PDF + 800px PNG
- microdiagram: 600x300 svg + 400px png
- routing slide: 1920x1080 pptx export

Tom Alvarez: Microdiagram approach: compact scatter with callouts vs stacked bars that show cost per 1k tokens. I did a compact scatter mock for mobile legibility.

Priya Singh: Scatter looks cleaner for social. For the one-pager, stacked bars with callouts give more narrative context. Use the primary palette but limit tonal range for accessibility. Add alt text in Figma comments.

Nate O'Connor: Inbound routing notes: use utm_campaign=serving_launch and hidden field source=serving_launch. Map leads to queue: inbound@ -> SDR triage -> tag product:serving-launch. MQL rule: demo_request=true OR account_revenue_est>=100k. Add this note on the routing slide for clarity.

Lena Park: Legal: include opt-in checkbox text per region; do not auto-check it. Also request: no salary or demographic questions on the form. We'll pre-approve the EN copy by tomorrow morning.

Tom Alvarez: Great. I pushed muted-palette microdiagram for small screens and a high-contrast variant for the PDF. Please review Figma and add copy lock by 11am tomorrow. Quick sync scheduled: 20-min review at 11:30am tomorrow in #marketing.

Rina Kapoor: Thanks all 130 Please leave final export notes in the Figma file (naming, pixel sizes, filename conventions). Also include a tiny checklist on the routing slide: UTMs, hidden field, MQL, legal check. That will help ops when routing leads. :thumbsup:
